Thank you for contacting RingCentral Customer Success! We’re currently reviewing your inquiry and will provide an update within 24-48 business hours. We appreciate your patience during this process. Here’s your case number for reference: {!$Record.CaseNumber}
If your inquiry requires immediate assistance, please feel free to contact us at (888) 898-4591 option 2. Our hours of operation are Monday to Friday, 6AM to 6PM PST.
We look forward to connecting with you soon.
Thank you! RingCentral Customer Success *Please do not reply to this email acknowledgement, we will reach out to you on the above given business hours.
